title: EventEA: Benchmarking Entity Alignment for Event-centric Knowledge Graphs

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the structural similarity of knowledge graph datasets using Weisfeiler-Lehman Subtree Kernels and demonstrating that existing structure-based entity alignment models fail when evaluated on a new dataset (EventEA) that lacks the highly isomorphic graph structures found in previous benchmarks.

Filtering out easy alignment pairs with high string similarities (>0.9) to prevent data leakage, and evaluating attribute-enhanced models to show that their prior high performance was artificially inflated by identical entity names rather than true semantic alignment.
